decisions.reason: The IMU module fits the core building-block system and costs little to stock and maintain, and the firm is growing with slack, so there is no performance shortfall that would trigger dropping it.
The AC voltage input module is prominently presented, extends the industrial measurement line, and serves industrial users the firm is targeting, so it likely meets aspirations.
The four-channel solid-state relay is a low-cost addition close to the existing offer, and an expanding firm with in-house production has the slack to carry it while results build.

The server room monitoring kit mainly repackages existing modules, so its incremental cost is low, though as a bundle it is somewhat more likely to be revised or retired during the move to newer connectors.
